title: PRIVC Atlas Development Indicators: 2024 Overview
summary: A sample annual overview demonstrating how public reports appear in the catalogue.
body:
This sample entry demonstrates the reading view for a public report. Replace this example with your own reviewed findings before publishing.

The catalogue combines public reports with drafts stored only in the current browser. To publish a report for every visitor, export reports.json and deploy it with the site.

title: Using Development Indicators in Policy Briefs
summary: A sample policy brief showing tags, searchable metadata and direct report links.
body:
This sample policy brief illustrates the article reader. Use the title, authors, publication year and tags to make research easy to discover.

When adding a PDF, place it in reports/pdf/ and enter its relative path, such as reports/pdf/brief.pdf.
